description: This file defines API routes for handling return-related operations in an e-commerce backend, including listing return policies, creating return requests, and retrieving returns by ID. It uses FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions, and depends on authentication to secure operations.

classes.name: Return
classes.description: Model representing a return record in the database.

classes.name: ReturnPolicy
classes.description: Model representing return policies, either global or per product.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Model representing an item in a customer’s order.

methods.name: list_policies(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves and returns all return policies, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: create_return(payload: ReturnCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new return request for a specified order item belonging to the current user, after verifying ownership.

methods.name: get_return(return_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches a specific return request by its ID, only if it belongs to the current user.
